detail: Phase0 passes; perf ablation on WH 64 cores: full 28.3/24.2us, no-reads 15.6/9.1, no-writes 15.9/14.7, neither 2.3/1.7 (16384x64 / 16384x32). Reads and writes each ~15us and sum -> shared resource. Hypothesis: DRAM bank camping: contiguous row split means all cores at same local step hit tile/stick indices congruent mod 4 -> 3 of 12 banks. Fix: per-core rotation of traversal start.

Per-core traversal rotation (reader+writer, one RT arg): 16384x32 24.2->19.6us, 32768x64 58.5->51.5us, 16384x64 28.3->26.8us. Split reader (2 input CBs, BRISC odd rows) and trid read-ahead implemented, correct (knob matrix 36/36), measured flat/slower -> parked at trivial defaults as live knobs.

what: Under --profile, a failing test produces no device profiler logs (No device logs found, no ops_perf CSV). Ablation profiling as described by /perf-measure (stub the payload) always fails a value check, so the ablation silently yields no numbers until the test is made non-asserting.
suggest: Document in /perf-measure ablation section and the --profile caveat: payload-stubbed runs must skip value asserts (e.g. env switch), or make --profile dump device logs even on test failure.

suggest: Note in the --profile docs to pass node IDs instead of -k expressions with spaces, or quote-preserve args in the wrapper.
